name: shuffle_by_salt with skip field in metadata.common_input_skip bucket (issue #174 variant)
_comment: Companion to shuffle_salt_reads_skip_field.json. The excluded_common set on pine-cpp merges three sources: config.skip, metadata.common_input_skip (#74 disjoint bucket layout), metadata.common_input_template. This variant uniquely pins the second source: _skip_branch is placed in metadata.common_input so shuffle actually invokes input.common('_skip_branch') and hits the excluded_common gate, while metadata.common_input_skip is the SOLE declaration marking it excluded (no top-level 'skip:' key, so source #1 is not involved). Commenting out the metadata.common_input_skip insertion in compute_input_field_spec flips this fixture's output, leaving the sister fixture unchanged — the source-pin holds. common_input_template already routes through templated_param and has separate coverage.

cases.name: common_input_skip source of the excluded_common set is also honored across all runtimes
